workflows.ci.yml:
# CI (core ADR-0071 row B12): 1 job runs `make ci`, the gate that the
# Makefile defines (verify, govulncheck, race tests with coverage, the
# Docker-built test packages, the integration suite, the release builds).
name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  # (job bodies trimmed; only the uses: lines are kept)
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5.6.0
        uses: jdx/mise-action@f5be966e4a917d54244728e6a5fdcd1d93a35e6c # v5.2.6
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@b9fd7d16f6d7d1b5d2bec1a2887e65ceed900238 # v4.6.0
workflows.release.yml:
name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'

permissions: {}

jobs:
  # (job bodies trimmed; only the uses: lines are kept)
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5.6.0
        uses: goreleaser/goreleaser-action@e435ccd777264be153ace6237001ef4d979d3a7a # v6.4.0
workflows.risk-paths.yml:
# Risk paths (frostyard/core ADR-0068, docs/specs/risk-paths.md): this caller
# runs on pull_request_target, so the base branch's risk list and caller run.
# It does not run a pull-request branch and checks out nothing. A pull request
# that touches a glob in .github/risk-paths.json gets the label risk:high.
# It is not a required check. The label risk:high must exist, or the job fails.
name: Risk paths caller

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  # (job bodies trimmed; only the uses: lines are kept)
    uses: frostyard/core/.github/workflows/risk-paths.yml@1b02a129026329cef2b46d1fbd0465a863c1cd81 # frostyard/core main, 2026-11-04 (core has no release tags)
